frozen.description: Round 2. Same labels/training recipe as round 1 (4-labeler averaged two-hot soft targets: gemini-3.1-flash-lite, claude-haiku-5.5, qwen3.7-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash, batched 10/call with SemEval guidance; gte-modernbert full FT, sentence-swap augmentation, lr 3e-5, bs 32, max_len 128) plus 7,571 NEW training pairs scored by the same 4-labeler ensemble: 6,571 re-pairings of pool sentences (gte-modernbert nearest neighbours, stratified by the round-1 student's predicted score) and 1,000 LLM-generated partner sentences at controlled similarity levels (deepseek-flash, steered by pool sentences). Fixed 4 epochs on all silver (no early stopping), 3 runs sharing the same init (init seed 0) with data-order seeds 0/1/2, uniformly weight-averaged (model soup) into one model; ONNX selective int8 (MLP Wo + head kept fp32). Dev: soup 0.9121 (deployed ONNX) vs round-1 recipe seed mean 0.8968 (6 seeds): paired bootstrap +0.0153, 95% CI [+0.0038, +0.0281]; vs round-1 deployed best-of-4 seed model +0.0019 (CI [-0.010, +0.013]). Member seeds 0.910/0.911/0.910.
